items.html:
A left-hand opening batsman with a Samoan mother and a Greek Cypriot father, Dom Michael debuted for Queensland in the 2012-13 season. However, after five Sheffield Shield appearances in two seasons, he signed with Tasmania for the 2014-15 summer, continuing his journeyman status - he has played second XI cricket for Kent and Surrey on a European passport and has also played one-day cricket for the Netherlands in England's 40-over competition.
ESPNcricinfo staff
